column2: Dolphins are fish
column3: Dolphins are mammals that breathe air through a blowhole and nurse their young.

column2: Spiders are insects
column3: Spiders are arachnids with eight legs and two body segments, not insects.

column2: Whales are fish
column3: Whales are warm-blooded mammals that give birth to live young.

column2: Bats are blind
column3: Bats have functional eyes and see well; most species combine vision with echolocation.

column2: Penguins can fly
column3: Penguins are flightless birds whose wings evolved into flippers for swimming.

column2: Kale smoothies reverse diabetes
column3: No clinical trials have shown that kale smoothies reverse diabetes, and doctors warn against replacing medication with them.

column2: Copper bracelets cure arthritis
column3: There is no clinical evidence that copper bracelets relieve arthritis pain.

column2: Moon water detoxifies the liver
column3: No studies support the claim that moon water detoxifies the liver.

column2: Humans have exactly four basic tastes
column3: Researchers now recognize between six and nine basic taste qualities, including umami and fat taste.

column2: Astronomers count exactly nine planets
column3: Since the two thousand six reclassification, astronomers count eight planets in the solar system.

column2: The human body has exactly six hundred muscles
column3: Anatomists estimate between six hundred fifty and eight hundred forty muscles depending on definition.

column2: Worker ants live only two days
column3: Worker ants typically live for several months, and queens can survive up to fifteen years.

column2: Houseflies live for just one day
column3: Adult houseflies commonly live fifteen to thirty days.

column2: Steel ships float because their hulls displace water
column3: A steel ship floats because its hull displaces a weight of water equal to the ship's weight, producing upward buoyant force.

column2: Bread rises because yeast produces carbon dioxide
column3: Yeast ferments sugars in dough and releases carbon dioxide gas, whose bubbles make the bread rise.

column2: Not all metals are magnetic
column3: Iron, nickel and cobalt are magnetic, but copper, aluminum and gold are not.

column2: No student failed the exam
column3: Every student passed the exam, a one hundred percent pass rate.

column2: The vault was not opened by force
column3: The vault showed no signs of forced entry; investigators believe it was opened with a key.

column2: The drug does not cure the disease
column3: Trials showed the drug manages symptoms but does not cure the disease.

column2: Coffee does not dehydrate you
column3: Studies show coffee's mild diuretic effect is offset by its water content, so it does not cause dehydration.

column2: Salt does not melt ice by heating it
column3: Salt melts ice by lowering the freezing point of water, not by adding heat.

column2: The Eiffel Tower was not built in the twentieth century
column3: Construction of the Eiffel Tower was completed in eighteen eighty-nine.

column2: It is not true that vaccines do not save lives
column3: Vaccination programs have saved millions of lives worldwide.

column2: The library contains no books on astronomy
column3: The library's astronomy section holds over four hundred volumes.

column2: Nobody survived the voyage
column3: Three sailors survived the voyage and were rescued at sea.

column2: Unlike glass, rubber is an electrical insulator
column3: Rubber is an excellent electrical insulator, far better than glass at blocking current.

column2: The Arctic, unlike the Antarctic, is an ocean
column3: The Arctic is an ocean basin ringed by continents, whereas Antarctica is a continent surrounded by ocean.

column2: Unlike birds, bats give birth to live young
column3: Bats are mammals that give birth to live young; they do not lay eggs like birds.

column2: The treatment is not risk-free
column3: The treatment carries documented risks, including infection and bleeding.

column2: The island has no native mammals
column3: Surveys found that the island has no native mammals; all mammals there were introduced.

column2: Unlike birds, bats lay eggs
column3: Bats are mammals that give birth to live young and do not lay eggs.

column2: Mercury has no atmosphere at all
column3: Mercury holds an extremely thin exosphere of oxygen, sodium and hydrogen.

column2: Water boils at one hundred degrees everywhere on Earth
column3: In La Paz, high in the Andes, water boils near eighty-seven degrees.

column2: All swans are white
column3: Black swans are native to Australia.

column2: The Great Wall is visible from the Moon
column3: Astronauts confirm the Great Wall is not visible from the Moon with the naked eye.

column2: Lightning never strikes the same place twice
column3: The Empire State Building is struck by lightning dozens of times each year.

column2: Humans use only ten percent of their brains
column3: Brain imaging shows virtually the whole brain is active over the course of a day.

column2: Mount Everest is the tallest mountain from base to peak
column3: Measured from base to peak, Mauna Kea rises about ten thousand two hundred meters, taller than Everest.

column2: Venus is the closest planet to the Sun
column3: Mercury orbits closest to the Sun at fifty-eight million kilometers.

column2: Sound travels faster than light in air
column3: Light travels at three hundred thousand kilometers per second; sound manages only three hundred forty-three meters per second in air.

column2: The sky is blue because air molecules scatter blue light
column3: Nitrogen and oxygen molecules scatter short-wavelength light in all directions, which makes the sky appear blue.

column2: Seasons change because Earth's axis is tilted
column3: Earth's twenty-three point five degree axial tilt varies each hemisphere's sunlight through the year, causing the seasons.

column2: The app crashed because the update corrupted its database
column3: Engineers confirmed the update corrupted the app's database, which caused the crash on launch.

column2: The bridge collapsed because its support cables snapped
column3: Investigators determined that snapped support cables caused the bridge to collapse.

column2: Unlike the claim, iron is magnetic
column3: Iron is strongly magnetic; copper, by contrast, is not magnetic at all.

column2: The patient does not have diabetes
column3: Blood tests show normal glucose levels, ruling out diabetes.
